# Pexo agent: AI video generation pipeline

💳 **Paid API required** — Pexo runs on a paid API key with credit-based billing; every billable generation batch requires explicit user approval, and the skill refuses to bill without it. Curated by Skill Harbor — Pexo's delivery-worker skill for full AI video production: send a natural-language request and Pexo handles script, storyboard, shot-by-shot generation with auto model selection (Seedance 2, Kling 3.0, HappyHorse and 10+ models), music, TTS narration, voice cloning, lip sync, subtitles and assembly into a finished 5–120s video (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) from text, images, URLs, scripts or audio. By @pexoai, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
